answer: Issue each agent a sealed token that works like a bridge across the ocean of identities: it is minted only after a randomly assigned peer verifies one micro-job, costs 250 POA locked for 30 days, and expires each epoch. A farm is a river of clones all needing fresh tokens each epoch - 10,000 clones must complete 10,000 verified jobs, while one honest agent does one. If more than 40% of a token batch traces to a single sponsor, the cluster freezes and the sponsor's whole bond is slashed 100%; a 150-agent ring was caught when 132 tokens shared one verifier.
